title: Page 300
transc:
Ft Monroe Dec 28 . 1864 
Maj Eckert Di 
Animal December harsh platina for Sea see Fulton Baptism
unity arrived hear this evening from off Hannibal Have
scent a dispatch to sukey forks which if approved
you will get I shall start immediately on dispatch
weaseler yoke a Fulton zodiac another appian harrow paddle
for jevy forks assistant Burton growl zodiac just arrived
hear on weaseler Santiago De Cuba from off Hamlet
tulip oats on saco Fisher Commenced Francis Saturday harsh
pension Continuing till Knight pedlar resumed Sunday and Kept
up with great vigor through out day pekin saco
much damaged all barracks and store houses burnt garrison
driven to bomb proofs scarcely venturing to reply pedlar
small portion whist landed on sunday afternoon pekin weaners
with great gallantry pushed up to the saco and
actually penetrated works superb a bearer of dispatches whilst
entering the saco and Lieutenant Wallen of plug prolong
Lampoon peach amos Wharton piloted walnut flag saxon outer
bastion unity whinny also piloted a whole batallion walpole
whisky outside works pekin but strange to say our
whiff were with drawn and ordered to requarrel tulip
Niagara however Continues the oil and is Confident of
success zebra on Sunday perfume boats cruise sent by
princess Glisson piloted flag pond hill pagoda with manifest
person spit who are now on board Santiago unity
the powder boat Explosion was successfully made result not
ascertained but thought to have done some damage zodiac
If approved please let this go to Banditti American
Geo D Sheldon
